scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme under NSKFDC- Haryana
description:
The Education Loan Scheme under the National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSKFDC) in Haryana was launched to provide financial assistance to students from Scheduled Castes who wish to pursue higher education.

This scheme was initiated in the year 2014 as part of the government’s commitment to enhance educational opportunities for marginalized communities.

The primary objective of the scheme is to ensure that students from Scheduled Castes have access to quality education without financial barriers.

The scheme aims to provide loans for various courses including professional and technical courses at graduate and postgraduate levels.

The maximum loan amount that can be availed under this scheme is up to INR 10 lakh for courses in India.

For courses abroad the maximum loan amount is capped at INR 20 lakh.

The interest rate on the loan is set at a subsidized rate of 4 percent per annum.

The repayment period for the loan is flexible and can extend up to 10 years after the completion of the course.

The scheme also includes a moratorium period during which no repayment is required.

This moratorium period lasts for the duration of the course plus one year.

Students must be between the ages of 18 to 35 years to be eligible for this scheme.

The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 8 lakh to qualify for the loan.

Students must have secured admission in recognized institutions for eligible courses.

The application process involves several steps to ensure that the applicants meet the necessary criteria.

First, applicants must fill out the application form available on the NSKFDC website or at designated offices.

Along with the application form, applicants must submit identity proof such as Aadhar card or voter ID.

Proof of admission to the educational institution is also required.

Additionally, applicants must provide income proof such as salary slips or income certificates.

The completed application form and documents should be submitted to the nearest NSKFDC office.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the officials for eligibility verification.

If approved, the loan amount will be disbursed directly to the educational institution.

Disbursement of the loan typically occurs in installments based on the fee structure of the institution.

The scheme is implemented by the NSKFDC which operates under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The contact details for NSKFDC can be found on their official website for any queries related to the scheme.

The scheme is designed to empower students from Scheduled Castes by providing them with the necessary financial support.

As of 2023, the scheme has benefited thousands of students across Haryana.

The government has allocated a significant budget for the scheme to ensure its sustainability and reach.

The scheme also aims to reduce dropout rates among Scheduled Caste students by easing financial burdens.

In the academic year 2022-2023, over 5000 students availed loans under this scheme.

The scheme has been instrumental in promoting higher education among marginalized communities.

It has also contributed to the overall development of the Scheduled Caste population in Haryana.

The government regularly reviews the scheme to enhance its effectiveness and reach.

Awareness programs are conducted to inform eligible students about the benefits of the scheme.

The scheme is part of a larger initiative by the government to promote social equity and inclusion.

Students are encouraged to apply early to ensure timely disbursement of funds.

The NSKFDC also provides guidance and support throughout the application process.

The scheme is aligned with the government’s vision of providing equal opportunities in education.

The interest subsidy is a significant benefit that reduces the financial burden on students.

The scheme has a positive impact on the socio-economic status of beneficiaries.

The government is committed to increasing the loan amount in the future based on inflation and educational costs.

The Education Loan Scheme under NSKFDC is a crucial step towards achieving educational empowerment.

The scheme reflects the government's dedication to supporting the education of underprivileged communities.

Students are advised to keep all documents ready before applying to streamline the process.

The scheme is expected to evolve with changing educational needs and economic conditions.

The NSKFDC also collaborates with banks to facilitate the loan process for students.

The initiative has garnered positive feedback from beneficiaries who have successfully completed their education.

The Education Loan Scheme is a testament to the government's efforts in promoting inclusive education.

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also encourages students to pursue their dreams.

In conclusion, the Education Loan Scheme under NSKFDC in Haryana is a vital program aimed at fostering educational opportunities for Scheduled Caste students.

It provides substantial financial support with favorable terms to ensure that no deserving student is left behind due to financial constraints.
